title: 9/17/2026 | JOHN B. BRADLEY - LAZY S RANCH | LTRS | Support of the request made by Kevin Kennedy and John Burrow in Item No. 6571, filed September 17, 2026, requesting an independent technical investigation of the modeling underlying ERCOT's 2024 PBRP

=== Investigation Letter of Support Signed.pdf ===
                                  LETTER OF SUPPORT

TO:           Public Utility Commission of Texas

FROM:         John B. Bradley III, Pro Se Intervenor

DATE:         September 17, 2026

SUBJECT:      Support for Request for Independent Investigation and Forensic Audit

RE:           PUC Docket No. 59475; Item No. 6571

I support Kevin Kennedy and John Burrow's request for an independent technical
investigation and forensic audit of the modeling underlying ERCOT's 2024 Permian Basin
Reliability Plan.

The ﬁling identiﬁes material questions regarding di erences between the PBRP and
contemporaneous 2024 Regional Transmission Plan models, including their load,
generation, and system-wide assumptions. Given that the Commission approved three
765-kV import paths totaling approximately 1,255 miles, these questions warrant careful
and independent examination. The requested audit would test the modeling rather than
presume wrongdoing, including whether the PBRP complied with applicable NERC
reliability and modeling requirements and whether its transmission recommendations
remain supported under reconciled system-wide assumptions.

Before Texas commits billions of dollars and extensive land to infrastructure of this scale,
the underlying technical foundation should be transparent, reproducible, and
independently veriﬁed. I respectfully request that the Commission order the independent
investigation and forensic technical audit requested in Item 6571 before taking further
action dependent upon the challenged PBRP modeling.

Reference: Kevin Kennedy and John M. Burrow, Response to Remand - Request for
Independent Investigation and Forensic Audit, PUC Docket No. 59475, Item No. 6571, ﬁled
September 17, 2026.

Respectfully submitted,



John B. Bradley III
Pro Se Intervenor

Lazy S Ranch
16767 Crows Ranch Rd
Salado, TX 76571
